title: Mountains worldwide as possible alien bases
place_text: Mount Zeil, Mount Hayes, Mount Perdido, Mount Shasta

tellings.quote: world. You have Mount Zeil and uh you know, you have Mount you know, that's in Australia. You have Mount Hayes in Alaska.

plain: The idea here is that certain mountains around the world might hide alien bases. Michels raises it in a conversation with the owner of a ranch known for strange sightings, listing peaks like Mount Zeil in Australia and Mount Hayes in Alaska, and the story also places Mount Perdido and Mount Shasta in the same list. He gives no source and no detail beyond the names of the mountains.
